onomixel.configuration.title: Onomixel Configuration
onomixel.config.screen.title: Onomixel Manga Audio Settings
onomixel.config.threatRadar.tooltip: Clamps off-screen and rear life-threatening sounds (creeper fuse, TNT, warden roar, ambush) onto screen borders with directional chevrons and distance meters.
onomixel.config.kineticTypography.toolti: Simulates fluid waves, exponential explosion head-scaling, and creeper fuse jitter on individual letter glyphs.
onomixel.config.speedOfSound.tooltip: Acoustically delays distant thunder and horns at 343 m/s sound speed for realistic atmospheric immersion.
onomixel.config.aestheticStyle.tooltip: Global comic visual style: Shonen Action, Retro Pop-Art, Medieval Calligraphy, or Cyberpunk Glitch.
onomixel.config.colorblindMode.tooltip: Remaps warning and ambient colors for players with color vision deficiencies.
onomixel.config.enabled.tooltip: Show sound words in the world. Vanilla subtitles keep their own setting.
onomixel.config.colorStyle.tooltip: Color palette for sound words: VIBRANT for high-contrast comic style, PASTEL for soft vanilla pastel style.
onomixel.config.displayMode.tooltip: Density: LIGHTWEIGHT (default, hides steps and reduces idle voices), BALANCED (moderate step cooldown), FULL (high cadence), ACTION_ONLY (actions, damage and landings; no idle voices or ambience). Local-player steps remain source-filtered.
onomixel.config.stepDurationScale.toolti: Duration multiplier for footsteps (0.2-2.0, default 0.50 = 50% of base duration).
onomixel.config.pickupDurationScale.tool: Duration multiplier for item and xp pickups (default 0.70).
onomixel.config.interactionDurationScale: Duration multiplier for chests, doors, levers (default 0.90).
onomixel.config.impactDurationScale.tool: Duration multiplier for hits, damage, landings and explosions (default 1.10).
onomixel.config.maxDistance.tooltip: Show sounds whose sources are within this distance from the camera (4–64 blocks).
onomixel.config.maxVisible.tooltip: Limit the words drawn on screen at once (1–50).
onomixel.config.durationSeconds.tooltip: Base duration defaults to 1 second (0.5–5 seconds), multiplied by the category setting. Repeats extend up to twice the initial effective lifetime.
onomixel.config.distanceScaling.tooltip: Gently increase text size at longer distances.
onomixel.config.fade.tooltip: Smoothly fade text at the start and end of its life.
